name: openpixo/sprite-idle-sheet-side
title: Side-view idle sheet
description: Step 1 of a side-view idle: one character drawn standing at rest facing right and facing left on a green screen, ready to animate with the side-view idle.

description_i18n.en: Step 1 of a side-view idle: one character drawn standing at rest facing right and facing left on a green screen, ready to animate with the side-view idle.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 侧视待机第 1 步：把角色在绿幕上画成朝右、朝左两个站立姿势，再用「侧视待机动画」让它动起来。

recipe.whenToUse: First step of a side-view idle: draw the idle sheet facing right and left, check it, then animate it with sprite-idle-side.

inputs.name: style
inputs.label: Art style (empty: match the game)

label_i18n.zh-CN: 美术风格（留空则跟随游戏）

inputs.placeholder: e.g. clean cartoon with bold outlines

placeholder_i18n.zh-CN: 例如：粗描边的简洁卡通

recipe.prompt: Game character pose sheet for a side-view idle animation: {{character.name}}, {{character.description}}. Two copies of the same character side by side in a strict grid of 2 columns by 1 row of equal cells on a 16:9 canvas, with no visible grid lines. Left cell: facing right. Right cell: facing left. The game camera of a side-scroller, platformer or brawler, level with the character or a little above it as the design is drawn, identical in both cells: each copy is seen from the side, in profile or turned slightly toward the viewer, the same amount in both. Every copy stands at rest in a relaxed idle pose: both feet planted a little apart, weight even, knees straight but not locked, arms relaxed, hands loose; a held weapon rests at ease. The facing-left copy is the same character turned around, not a mirror image: one-sided details such as a weapon, a shield, a bag, a scarf end or a hair parting stay on the same side of the body, so a detail on the near side in one copy is on the far side in the other. Identical design, colours, proportions and size in both copies; where reference images are provided, follow them exactly. Each copy is centred in its cell with its whole body visible, about 60 percent of the cell height, the same scale as the character's other side-view sheets, feet on the same baseline, with clear empty space around it; nothing crosses into the other cell. Style: {{style}}, crisp clean edges, flat even lighting, no cast shadows. Background: one flat, perfectly uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) across the whole image, with no gradient, floor, shadow, scenery or grid lines. Nothing on the character is bright green.
recipe.negative: text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, logo, border, frame, grid lines, gradient background, floor, cast shadow, scenery, vignette, walking, mid-stride, running, action pose, crossed legs, motion blur, speed lines, extra characters, cropped, cut off at the edge, overlapping cells, inconsistent character between cells, changing size, bright green clothing, weapons or props not in the reference
